# Navoryn

> Navoryn is an independent digital studio that designs and builds high-performance websites, web apps, mobile apps and custom dashboards for ambitious businesses.

## Services

- [Web development](/web-development): Websites, customer portals and web applications
- [SaaS and MVP development](/saas-mvp-development): Product foundations and scalable SaaS platforms

- [UI/UX and product design](/ui-ux-product-design): Interface design, UX research and design systems
- [Website and app redesign](/website-app-redesign): Visual, performance and frontend modernization
- [SEO and digital growth](/seo-digital-growth): Technical SEO, content and analytics
- [API and platform integrations](/api-platform-integrations): Custom APIs and third-party integrations
- [Social media integrations](/social-media-integrations): Social login, feeds and lead integrations
- [Business automation](/business-automation): Workflow, notification and reporting automation
- [E-commerce and payments](/ecommerce-payments): Online stores and payment integrations
- [Legacy modernization](/legacy-modernization): Upgrading and migrating older systems
- [Maintenance and optimization](/maintenance-optimization): Ongoing support and performance tuning
